patch_description: This replaces single-point simulated annealing with a deterministic population-based covariance-adaptation strategy. Several independent elite-search islands maintain distributions over all eight movable points simultaneously, allowing coordinated motions that can escape bottlenecks where moving one point alone decreases the current minimum area. Candidates are ranked lexicographically: true minimum normalized area is dominant, with a tiny lower-tail support statistic only resolving numerical near-ties. A final active-constraint batch polish specifically perturbs points participating in the smallest triangles.
